name: Unidentified Taylander shuttle
description: A Taylander shuttle was operated by a human pilot as part of the Rebel Alliance Navy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Around 3 ABY, the shuttle was boarded by the droid C-3PO, who was in the control of Scourge, who killed the human pilot and utilized the Taylander shuttle to traverse to the planet Mustafar.
